title: Senior Clinical Care Specialist (HIV/AIDS & ART)
summary: Provide senior technical leadership in the expansion of antiretroviral therapy (ART), Advanced HIV Disease (AHD) management, and PMTCT across supported healthcare facilities.
responsibilities: Lead clinical mentorship and capacity building for doctors and nurses across target healthcare facilities.
Support the implementation of PEPFAR/CDC clinical guidelines for Advanced HIV Disease (AHD) and PMTCT.
Analyze facility-level treatment outcomes, viral suppression rates, and design quality improvement projects.
Collaborate with State Ministries of Health and National AIDS/STI Control Programs (NASCP).
requirements: Bachelor of Medicine, Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) from a recognized university.
Master of Public Health (MPH) or equivalent postgraduate qualification.
Minimum of 7 years post-NYSC clinical experience, with at least 4 years in PEPFAR-funded HIV programs.
Active registration with the Medical and Dental Council of Nigeria (MDCN).

title: Strategic Information / M&E Officer
qualification: B.Sc / M.Sc Health Informatics, Statistics, or Computer Science
summary: Manage facility routine data collection, data quality assurance (DQA), NDR synchronization, and reporting into donor portals.
responsibilities: Oversee data entry, validation, and monthly reporting across supported health facility sites.
Conduct regular Data Quality Assessments (DQA) and routine data auditing.
Build custom analytical dashboards for program managers using PowerBI or Tableau.
Troubleshoot Electronic Medical Record (EMR) system synchronization issues at facility sites.
requirements: Degree in Statistics, Health Informatics, Computer Science, Demography, or Public Health.
Minimum 4 years experience in health data management, preferably in HIV/TB or RMNCH programs.
Proficiency in SQL, Stata/SPSS, DHIS2, and National Data Repository (NDR) tools.

title: Short-Term Technical Advisor — PPH E-MOTIVE Clinical Training
qualification: FWACS / FMCOG in Obstetrics & Gynaecology or MPH
summary: Short-term expert consultant to deliver intensive clinical training on Postpartum Hemorrhage (PPH) E-MOTIVE clinical care bundles across secondary facilities.
responsibilities: Deliver 5-day competency-based clinical masterclasses on PPH E-MOTIVE care bundles to facility doctors and midwives.
Evaluate baseline vs post-training clinical skills using standardized OSCE checklists.
Produce a technical consultancy report detailing clinical recommendations for Lagos State Ministry of Health.
requirements: Fellowship in Obstetrics & Gynaecology (FWACS/FMCOG) or Senior Obstetrician with MPH.
At least 8 years experience in maternal health clinical training and PPH bundle scaling.
Proven track record of publishing or facilitating WHO maternal health guidelines.

title: Health Systems Strengthening & Policy Fellow
qualification: B.Sc Public Health, Health Economics, or Public Policy
summary: 12-month fellowship supporting state-level health financing policy, basic healthcare provision fund (BHCPF) rollout, and primary healthcare facility accreditation.
responsibilities: Assist in mapping state-level health insurance coverage and BHCPF disbursement metrics.
Participate in joint supervisory visits with State Primary Health Care Development Agencies.
Draft policy briefs and technical abstracts on healthcare financing models.
requirements: Degree in Public Health, Health Economics, Public Policy, or related field.
Demonstrated passion for health equity, universal health coverage (UHC), and policy formulation.
Strong research, quantitative analysis, and writing skills.
